headline: As of 2026-10-04: 1,188,821 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 30 of 50 states, D+33.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,188,821 early/mail ballots cast so far across 30 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+33.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (348,749), New Jersey (154,812), Florida (146,038).
